lines.name: Stand Up
lines.bar: The repository stands on its own: the old text UI is gone and the simulation it sat on is untouched and green; a century can be saved at any turn and picked up by another process, with every chain ruling still doing what it did; and a civkings package starts a game and proves in one command that it plays and saves
lines.note: 2026-11-19: first campaign of the civkings-one roadmap (the map-first game the design in that repository describes). The owner decided the same day that the engine builds it from the approved design. Authored on the human path; the triple was run by hand against BASE, against a lazy stub and against an honest minimum before it was sealed.
